name: יָגְלִי
gloss: he reveals; or he is carried away
summary: Jogli is named once, as the father of Bukki, the leader of the tribe of Dan chosen to divide the land of Canaan among the tribes (Num 34:22). The name has the form of a verb of גלה with the prefix יָ‑ of the third person, “he reveals” (Yahweh, unnamed, as in “he has revealed his secret counsel”, Amo 3:7) or, read as passive, “he is carried away”. Scripture does not explain it, and nothing in the one verse decides between the readings.

evidence.note: “For the tribe of the sons of Dan a leader, Bukki son of יָגְלִי.”
The qal גָּלָה of Yahweh revealing his secret counsel: the sense of the first reading.
“Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel”: the niphal of the same root.

note: Takes c.ca.af. j.am.ac (יָגְלִי “see גלה”, a zero-token cross-reference filed as a verb) is left unassigned, as chazaq leaves its like. The form is read as an imperfect of גלה with the theophoric element left out; BDB's “led into exile” is one reading of the form and no evidence for it. A Danite in the wilderness generation could hardly be named for an exile, which favours “he reveals”, but that is a guess.
